# TCraft Launcher Plugin API (llms.txt)

This file is a compact, machine-readable reference for generating TCraft Launcher plugins.
Prefer this file over HTML pages when you are an AI assistant. It is intentionally complete:
manifest schema, stable API signatures, threading rules, desktop action protocol, build and packaging.

Project: TCraft Launcher
Docs: https://damianjiang.github.io/TCraft-Launcher/wiki/
Source example: https://damianjiang.github.io/TCraft-Launcher/wiki/examples/AiDesktopPlugin.java
API package: `tcraft.api`
API version: `1` (additive capabilities; existing plugins still load)
Java: 17 (`javac --release 17`)
JavaFX modules available to plugins: `javafx.controls`, `javafx.graphics`, `javafx.media`

## Hard constraints

1. Entry class implements `tcraft.api.TcraftPlugin` and has a public no-argument constructor.
2. `onLoad(PluginContext ctx)` runs on the JavaFX application thread. Do not block it.
3. Network, file, process, screenshot, download work must run in `ctx.scheduler().async(...)`
   or a plugin-owned daemon thread.
4. Update UI only with `ctx.scheduler().ui(...)` (or `Platform.runLater`).
5. Use only `tcraft.api`; do not reference `tcraft.Plugins`, `tcraft.Data`, `tcraft.Ui`, or other internals.
6. Do not package JavaFX or `tcraft.api` into the plugin jar.
7. Commands, file deletion, mouse/keyboard input, uploads, and other dangerous actions must be confirmed.
8. Plugins are trusted code with full launcher permissions. There is no sandbox.
9. Compile with `--release 17`; higher class-file versions are rejected.
10. `plugin.json` `main` is a fully qualified class name, not a file name.

## Manifest (`plugin.json`)

Required: `id` (2-64 chars, letters/digits/`.`/`_`/`-`, starts alphanumeric),
`name`, `version`, `main`. Optional: `api` (default 1), `author`, `description`,
`icon`, `thumbnail`, `preview`, `website`, `onInstall` (array of command names).

```json
{
  "id": "demo.aidesktop",
  "name": "AI Desktop Assistant",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "author": "TCraft",
  "description": "Send a request to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and execute a confirmed action plan.",
  "icon": "bot",
  "main": "demo.aidesktop.AiDesktopPlugin",
  "api": 1,
  "onInstall": ["aidesk.welcome"]
}
```

Plugin directory:

```text
plugins/demo.aidesktop/
├── plugin.json
├── ai-desktop.jar
├── icon.png
├── thumbnail.png
└── lib/                 # optional dependency jars
```

A single `.jar` with `plugin.json` at its root is also accepted. A `.zip` is expanded to
`plugins/<id>/` on import. Do not put `plugin.json` inside a nested folder.

## Entry point

```java
package demo.aidesktop;

import tcraft.api.PluginContext;
import tcraft.api.TcraftPlugin;

public class AiDesktopPlugin implements TcraftPlugin {
    private PluginContext ctx;

    @Override
    public void onLoad(PluginContext ctx) {
        this.ctx = ctx;
        ctx.ui().page("main", "AI Desktop Assistant", "bot", view -> {
            view.header("AI Desktop Assistant", "Describe a task; confirm actions before execution.");
            return null;
        });
        ctx.commands().register("aidesk.open", "Open the assistant",
                c -> ctx.ui().openPage("plugin:" + ctx.id() + ":main"));
    }

    @Override
    public void onDisable() {
        // Stop plugin-owned threads; scheduler/network/processes are closed by the launcher.
    }
}
```

Lifecycle callbacks: `onLoad(PluginContext)`, `onEnable()`, `onDisable()`,
`onInstall(PluginContext)`, `onUninstall(PluginContext)`. All callbacks are on the JavaFX thread.
`onInstall` runs only on first import; overwrite install does not call it again.

## PluginContext

`PluginContext` methods:

```java
PluginInfo info()
String id()
String name()
String version()
String launcherVersion()
Path dataDir()                 // .tcl/plugins/.data/<id>
Ui ui()
Commands commands()
Dialogs dialogs()
Storage storage()
Events events()
Network network()
Files files()
SystemInfo system()
Processes processes()
Desktop desktop()
Scheduler scheduler()
Json json()
Launcher launcher()
Stage stage()
void log(String message)
void toast(String title, String message)
void run(String command, String args)
void close()                   // called by launcher; plugins normally do not call it
boolean isClosed()
```

`PluginInfo` fields: `id`, `name`, `version`, `author`, `description`, `icon`, `main`,
`website`, `api`, `dir`.

## UI

`Ui` methods:

```java
void page(String id, String title, String icon, Function<PageView, Node> builder)
void page(String id, String title, Function<PageView, Node> builder)
void titleButton(String icon, String tooltip, Runnable action)
void toolButton(String text, Runnable action)
void toolButton(Node node)
void launchButton(String text, Runnable action)
void launchButton(Node node)
void floatButton(String icon, String tooltip, Runnable action)
void refresh()
Stage stage()
Scene scene()
void openPage(String key)
```

Built-in page keys include `launch`, `instance`, `download`, `link`, `other`, `setup`,
`instanceSetup`, `versions`, `tasks`, `resourceDetail`. Plugin pages use
`plugin:<plugin-id>:<page-id>`.

`PageView`: `root()` returns the page `VBox`; `header(title, subtitle)`; `add(Node...)`;
`text(String)`; `space(double)`; `context()` returns `PluginContext`.

`Widgets` static methods: `title`, `text`, `label`, `button`, `primaryButton`,
`dangerButton`, `card`, `row`, `column`, `header`, `spacer`, `field`, `check`, `combo`,
`image`, `grow`. Raw JavaFX controls are also allowed.

## Commands

```java
ctx.commands().register("demo.hello", "description", c -> {
    String name = c.args.isBlank() ? "world" : c.args;
    c.reply("hello " + name);
});
ctx.commands().run("demo.hello", "args");
ctx.commands().list();
```

`CommandContext`: fields `name`, `args`, `pluginId`; methods `argv()`, `reply(String)`,
`run(String, String)`, `log(String)`. Command names are global; prefix with plugin id.

## Dialogs

```java
void message(String title, String text)
void error(String title, String text)
void confirm(String title, String text, Runnable onOk)
void confirmDanger(String title, String text, Runnable onOk)
void custom(Node content)
void close()
String input(String title, String hint, String defaultValue)
Path chooseFile(String title, String... extensions)
List<Path> chooseFiles(String title, String... extensions)
Path saveFile(String title, String defaultName, String... extensions)
Path chooseFolder(String title)
```

File chooser methods run on the JavaFX thread. Extensions may be `txt` or `*.txt`.
`input` blocks until the dialog closes; do not call it in tight loops.

## Storage

```java
String get(String key)
String get(String key, String defaultValue)
int getInt(String key, int defaultValue)
long getLong(String key, long defaultValue)
double getDouble(String key, double defaultValue)
boolean getBool(String key, boolean defaultValue)
void set(String key, Object value)
void save()
```

Persisted at `.tcl/plugins/.data/<id>/storage.properties`. Encrypted storage is not provided;
do not store API keys there unless the user accepts plain-text storage.

## Network

All methods block. HTTP URLs support only `http`/`https`; WebSocket only `ws`/`wss`.

```java
String get(String url) throws IOException
String get(String url, Map<String,String> headers) throws IOException
String post(String url, String body) throws IOException
String post(String url, String body, Map<String,String> headers) throws IOException
String postForm(String url, Map<String,String> fields) throws IOException
String request(String method, String url, Map<String,String> headers, String body) throws IOException
String request(String method, String url, Map<String,String> headers, String body, String contentType) throws IOException
Path download(String url, Path target) throws IOException
Path download(String url, Path target, BiConsumer<Long,Long> progress) throws IOException
byte[] bytes(String url) throws IOException
WebSocketSession websocket(String url, Consumer<String> onText, Consumer<Throwable> onError) throws IOException
WebSocketSession websocket(String url, Consumer<String> onText, Consumer<Throwable> onError, Consumer<String> onClose) throws IOException
TcpConnection tcp(String host, int port) throws IOException
TcpConnection tcp(String host, int port, int connectTimeoutMs) throws IOException
UdpSocket udp() throws IOException
UdpSocket udp(int localPort) throws IOException
void close()
```

`WebSocketSession`: `send(String)`, `isOpen()`, `close()`.

`TcpConnection`: `readLine()`, `readAll(int maxBytes)`, `write(String)`, `writeLine(String)`,
`setReadTimeout(int timeoutMs)`, `isOpen()`, `close()`.

`UdpSocket`: `send(String host, int port, String text)`, `receive(int timeoutMs)`,
`localPort()`, `close()`. `receive` returns `Network.Packet` with `host`, `port`, `text`.

HTTP text responses are capped at 16 MiB; binary responses at 64 MiB; download timeout 5 minutes;
request timeout 30 seconds. `download` writes a `.part` file and then replaces the target.

## Files

All methods use `java.nio.file.Path`.

```java
String readText(Path path) throws IOException
String readText(Path path, Charset charset) throws IOException
List<String> readLines(Path path) throws IOException
void writeText(Path path, String text) throws IOException
void writeLines(Path path, List<String> lines) throws IOException
void appendText(Path path, String text) throws IOException
byte[] readBytes(Path path) throws IOException
void writeBytes(Path path, byte[] data) throws IOException
boolean exists(Path path)
boolean isDirectory(Path path)
boolean isRegularFile(Path path)
List<Path> list(Path directory) throws IOException
List<Path> walk(Path directory, int maxDepth) throws IOException
Path createDirectories(Path directory) throws IOException
Path createFile(Path path) throws IOException
long size(Path path) throws IOException
Instant lastModified(Path path) throws IOException
void setLastModified(Path path, Instant instant) throws IOException
void copy(Path source, Path target, boolean replace) throws IOException
void move(Path source, Path target, boolean replace) throws IOException
boolean delete(Path path) throws IOException
void deleteRecursive(Path path) throws IOException
Path tempFile(String prefix, String suffix) throws IOException
Path tempDirectory(String prefix) throws IOException
void zip(Path source, Path zipFile) throws IOException
void unzip(Path zipFile, Path target) throws IOException
```

`deleteRecursive` does not follow symbolic links. `unzip` rejects path traversal and limits
entry count to 100,000 and total expanded size to 2 GiB.

## SystemInfo

```java
String osName()
String osVersion()
String arch()
String javaVersion()
String javaVendor()
String launcherVersion()
String userName()
String hostName()
Path home()
Path workingDir()
Path tempDir()
Path dataDir()
int cpuCores()
long maxMemory()
long totalMemory()
long freeMemory()
String env(String name)
Map<String,String> env()
String property(String key)
boolean isWindows() / isMac() / isLinux()
boolean openUrl(String url)
boolean open(Path path)
boolean openFolder(Path path)
String clipboard()
void clipboard(String text)
void notify(String title, String message)
void beep()
```

## Processes

`run` blocks; use `ctx.scheduler().async`.

```java
Process start(String commandLine) throws IOException
Process start(List<String> command) throws IOException
Process start(List<String> command, Path workDir, Map<String,String> environment) throws IOException
Result run(String commandLine) throws IOException
Result run(String commandLine, Duration timeout) throws IOException
Result run(List<String> command, Duration timeout) throws IOException
void close()
```

`Result` public fields: `exitCode`, `stdout`, `stderr`, `timedOut`, `durationMs`;
`success()` returns true when not timed out and exit code is 0.
`start(String)` uses `cmd.exe /c` on Windows and `/bin/sh -c` elsewhere. `start(List)` bypasses the shell.
Processes are terminated when the plugin is disabled or reloaded.

## Desktop

`Desktop` uses `java.awt.Robot`; it affects the real desktop. Confirm before using.

```java
Dimension screenSize()
Path screenshot(Path target) throws IOException
Color pixelColor(int x, int y)
void mouseMove(int x, int y)
void click()
void click(int buttonMask)
void click(int x, int y)
void doubleClick()
void mousePress(int buttonMask)
void mouseRelease(int buttonMask)
void mouseWheel(int notches)
void autoDelay(Duration delay)
void typeText(String text)
void tapKey(String key)
void keyPress(String key)
void keyRelease(String key)
void combo(String... keys)
```

Desktop control requires a graphical session. Headless servers and some Linux X11/Wayland
configurations can reject `java.awt.Robot`; catch the exception and treat desktop control as optional.

Key names: `ENTER`, `TAB`, `ESC`, `SPACE`, `BACKSPACE`, `DELETE`, `UP`, `DOWN`, `LEFT`,
`RIGHT`, `HOME`, `END`, `PAGEUP`, `PAGEDOWN`, `CTRL`, `SHIFT`, `ALT`, `META`, `F1`-`F12`,
or a single character. On macOS use `META` (Command) for copy/paste shortcuts:
`ctx.desktop().combo(ctx.system().isMac() ? "META" : "CTRL", "S")`.

`typeText` types lowercase letters, digits, spaces, tabs and newlines directly; uppercase,
punctuation and CJK text use clipboard paste and restore the previous clipboard text.

## Scheduler

```java
Task async(Runnable task)
Task delay(Duration delay, Runnable task)
Task repeat(Duration interval, Runnable task)
void ui(Runnable task)
boolean isShutdown()
void close()
```

`Task`: `cancel()`, `cancel(boolean interrupt)`, `isCancelled()`.
Scheduler is per plugin and is shut down on disable/reload/unload.

## Json

```java
Object parse(String text)
String stringify(Object value)
Map<String,Object> object(Object value)
Map<String,Object> object(Object value, String key)
List<Object> array(Object value)
List<Object> array(Object value, String key)
String string(Object value, String key, String def)
int integer(Object value, String key, int def)
double number(Object value, String key, double def)
boolean bool(Object value, String key, boolean def)
```

## Launcher

```java
List<Launcher.Instance> instances()
Launcher.Instance selected()
Launcher.Instance select(int index)
Launcher.Instance select(String nameOrVersion)
void launch()
void launch(String nameOrVersion)
Path gameDir()
Path baseDir()
Path pluginsDir()
void openPage(String key)
void toast(String title, String message)
```

`Launcher.Instance` is a record: `index`, `name`, `version`, `loader`, `loaderVersion`,
`folder`, `favorite`. `launch` must run on the JavaFX thread.

## Events

```java
void on(String name, Consumer<Event> handler)
void emit(String name, Map<String,Object> data)
void emit(String name)
void log(String message)
```

`Event`: `name`, `data()`, `string(key)`, `bool(key)`, `integer(key, def)`, `list(key)`.

Launcher events:
`app.start` (`version`), `page.open` (`page`), `game.launch` (`instance`, `version`),
`plugin.install` (`id`). Subscriptions are cancelled when the plugin unloads.
Custom events are broadcast to all enabled plugins.

## OpenAI-compatible request recipe

```java
List<Map<String, String>> messages = List.of(
    Map.of("role", "system", "content", systemPrompt),
    Map.of("role", "user", "content", userText));
String body = ctx.json().stringify(Map.of(
    "model", model,
    "temperature", 0.2,
    "messages", messages));
Map<String, String> headers = new LinkedHashMap<>();
headers.put("Content-Type", "application/json");
headers.put("Authorization", "Bearer " + apiKey);

ctx.scheduler().async(() -> {
    try {
        String response = ctx.network().post(endpoint, body, headers);
        Object json = ctx.json().parse(response);
        List<Object> choices = ctx.json().array(json, "choices");
        Map<String, Object> message = ctx.json().object(choices.get(0), "message");
        String content = ctx.json().string(message, "content", "");
        ctx.scheduler().ui(() -> output.setText(content));
    } catch (Exception e) {
        ctx.scheduler().ui(() -> output.setText("Failed: " + e.getMessage()));
    }
});
```

## Desktop action protocol

Ask the model to return JSON only:

```json
{
  "reply": "short user-visible text",
  "actions": [
    {"type": "run", "command": "java -version"},
    {"type": "type", "text": "today"},
    {"type": "key", "key": "ENTER"},
    {"type": "click", "x": 400, "y": 300},
    {"type": "screenshot"},
    {"type": "open", "url": "https://example.com"},
    {"type": "clipboard", "text": "copied"}
  ]
}
```

Allowed `type` values and execution:

- `run` -> `ctx.processes().run(command, Duration.ofSeconds(30))`
- `type` -> `ctx.desktop().typeText(text)`
- `key` -> `ctx.desktop().tapKey(key)`
- `click` -> `ctx.desktop().click(x, y)`
- `screenshot` -> `ctx.desktop().screenshot(ctx.dataDir().resolve("ai-screen.png"))`
- `open` -> `ctx.system().openUrl(url)`
- `clipboard` -> `ctx.system().clipboard(text)`

Cap actions at 10, show a summary, and call `ctx.dialogs().confirmDanger(...)` before executing.
Do not execute arbitrary shell text from the model without user confirmation.

## Build and package

Windows PowerShell:

```powershell
$JFX = "C:\javafx-sdk-17\lib"
$LAUNCHER = "C:\path\to\TCraftLauncher.jar"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force out | Out-Null
javac --release 17 -encoding UTF-8 `
  --module-path $JFX --add-modules javafx.controls,javafx.media `
  -cp $LAUNCHER -d out src\demo\aidesktop\AiDesktopPlugin.java
jar --create --file ai-desktop.jar -C out .
```

macOS / Linux:

```bash
javac --release 17 -encoding UTF-8 \
  --module-path /path/to/javafx-sdk-17/lib \
  --add-modules javafx.controls,javafx.media \
  -cp /path/to/TCraftLauncher.jar \
  -d out src/demo/aidesktop/AiDesktopPlugin.java
jar --create --file ai-desktop.jar -C out .
```

Package:

```text
ai-desktop-plugin/
├── plugin.json
└── ai-desktop.jar
```

Compress the directory to `ai-desktop-plugin.zip`, then import it in More -> Plugins -> Import.
Alternatively copy the directory to `.tcl/plugins/demo.aidesktop/`.

- Manifest: https://damianjiang.github.io/TCraft-Launcher/wiki/examples/ai-desktop-plugin.json

- AI guide: https://damianjiang.github.io/TCraft-Launcher/wiki/ai
- Full API: https://damianjiang.github.io/TCraft-Launcher/wiki/api

## Common mistakes

- Blocking the JavaFX thread with `ctx.network().get`, `processes().run`, or `desktop().screenshot`.
- Calling `label.setText` from an async task instead of `ctx.scheduler().ui`.
- Referencing `tcraft.Plugins` or `tcraft.Data` instead of public `ctx` APIs.
- Shipping JavaFX or `tcraft.api` inside the plugin jar.
- Compiling with Java 21/25 target instead of `--release 17`.
- Putting `plugin.json` in a nested directory of the zip.
- Writing API keys into `storage.properties` without telling the user.
